findings.summary: isPublished() crashes the build when a /blog/<slug> link doesn't resolve to a known article.
findings.mechanism: articles.get(match[1]) returns undefined for any link whose slug isn't an exact filename match in packages/content/articles (e.g. a stale/renamed slug, or `/blog/tag/foo`-style URL where the regex captures `tag`). isPublished(undefined) then does `if (article.draft)`, throwing a TypeError and failing the entire site build instead of leaving the link alone or treating it as unpublished.

findings.summary: The plugin's publish check omits the DEV-mode bypass that the canonical isPublished() in data-utils.ts applies.
findings.mechanism: data-utils.ts's isPublished returns true when `import.meta.env.DEV`, so draft/future posts render normally in local dev. This plugin's isPublished has no such bypass, so during `pnpm dev` it will strip internal links to draft/future posts that the rest of the site still displays as reachable — contradicting the stated goal of using 'the same rule the rest of the site applies'.
